# Local Issue Runner Task List

Source: `tasks\local-issue-runner\spec.md`

## Relevant Files

- `tasks\local-issue-runner\spec.md` - Authoritative product specification and acceptance criteria for the runner.
- `tasks\local-issue-runner\tasks-spec.md` - Approved Phase 1 parent-task list that this Phase 2 expansion fills in.
- `pyproject.toml` - Python 3.11 package metadata plus pytest, Ruff, and strict Pyright configuration for the new runner package.
- `local_issue_runner\__main__.py` - `uv run python -m local_issue_runner ...` entry point for all operator commands.
- `local_issue_runner\cli.py` - CLI command parsing and human-readable console output for `doctor`, `plan`, `run`, `status`, `pause`, `resume`, `release`, `acknowledge`, `retry`, and `qualify`.
- `local_issue_runner\config.py` - TOML config loading, path resolution, and compatibility validation.
- `local_issue_runner\models.py` - Typed records and tagged unions for features, snapshots, deliveries, blockers, actions, and observed transitions.
- `local_issue_runner\db.py` - SQLite connection management, foreign-key enforcement, and transaction helpers.
- `local_issue_runner\migrations.py` - Explicit schema creation and migration logic.
- `local_issue_runner\locking.py` - Repository-scoped mutation lock and control-request coordination.
- `local_issue_runner\github_api.py` - `gh`-backed adapters for issues, dependencies, PRs, reviews, comments, checks, rules, and merges.
- `local_issue_runner\git_ops.py` - Fetch, worktree, branch, ancestry, base-update, and cleanup operations.
- `local_issue_runner\graph.py` - Feature DAG reconstruction, cycle detection, and ready-node calculation via `graphlib`.
- `local_issue_runner\scope.py` - Scope manifests, requirement fingerprints, and selective invalidation when requirements change.
- `local_issue_runner\scheduler.py` - Per-feature slot accounting, fairness, and action prioritization.
- `local_issue_runner\agent_backend.py` - Noninteractive Copilot CLI job execution, structured-result parsing, and log capture.
- `local_issue_runner\validation.py` - Exact-tree validation execution and persisted evidence records.
- `local_issue_runner\feedback.py` - External-feedback normalization, reply/resolution intents, dispositions, and quiet-period handling.
- `local_issue_runner\checks.py` - Required-check evaluation, CI timers, and no-progress problem tracking.
- `local_issue_runner\completion.py` - Child-completion verification, issue closure, acknowledgements, and dependency unlocking.
- `local_issue_runner\integration.py` - Parent readiness, integration PR lifecycle, and integration-repair child creation.
- `local_issue_runner\merge_policy.py` - Child and parent merge-eligibility evaluation and expected-head merge execution.
- `local_issue_runner\cleanup.py` - Safe worktree and branch cleanup after verified completion.
- `local_issue_runner\qualify.py` - Disposable-repository qualification exercise and receipt recording.
- `local_issue_runner\reconcile.py` - `decide_next(...)` and `reconcile_once(...)`, the core decision-and-execution loop.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\conftest.py` - Shared fake GitHub, fake Copilot, fake clock, SQLite, and temp-repo fixtures.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\fixtures\` - Sample configs, fake `gh` JSON, and temporary-repo templates used by deterministic tests.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_doctor.py` - Tests for config validation, tool compatibility checks, and read-only `doctor`.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_plan_snapshot.py` - Tests for child discovery, DAG snapshots, `plan`, and read-only next-action previews.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_coordinator.py` - Tests for the single lock-holding coordinator, controls, and crash recovery.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_child_delivery.py` - Tests for one owned child implementation loop through validation.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_child_prs.py` - Tests for push, PR creation, ownership, and PR-creation recovery.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_child_completion.py` - Tests for merge observation, acknowledgement, closure, and dependency unlocking.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_scope_reconciliation.py` - Tests for reopened issues, changed scope, and invalidated dependencies.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_scheduling.py` - Tests for concurrency, slot limits, fairness, and waiting-state behavior.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_feedback.py` - Tests for PR comments, review threads, and exactly-once responses.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_ci_repair.py` - Tests for required checks, repair dispatch, timers, and repeated no-progress stops.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_parent_integration.py` - Tests for parent readiness, integration PRs, and repair children.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_merge_readiness.py` - Tests for merge gating without executing merges.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_child_automerge_cleanup.py` - Tests for child qualification, child automerge, and owned-artifact cleanup.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_parent_automerge.py` - Tests for parent qualification, parent automerge, and final feature completion.
- `local_issue_runner\tests\test_end_to_end.py` - Bounded end-to-end lifecycle tests that exercise the public reconciliation interface across multiple parents and deliveries.

### Notes

- **This feature follows Test-Driven Development.** For every code-bearing parent task: write targeted tests first, run them to confirm failure, then implement, then refactor and rerun the targeted green checks.
- Run CLI commands as `uv run python -m local_issue_runner ...`.
- Run tests as `uv run pytest ...`; keep most coverage at the public reconciliation interface with fakes plus real temporary Git repositories.
- Keep this as a new `local_issue_runner` package; do not extend `orchestrator\` beyond borrowing test and lifecycle patterns.
- Parent tasks are intentionally dependency-aware: `1.0`-`3.0` establish safe read-only inspection and single-coordinator control, `4.0`-`7.0` establish one-child delivery and scope-change correctness, `8.0`-`10.0` add concurrency, feedback, and repair behavior, and `11.0`-`14.0` add parent integration plus staged merge autonomy.

## Verification Criteria

How we know the Local Issue Runner satisfies the spec end to end:

- [ ] Run `uv run python -m local_issue_runner doctor --config local_issue_runner\tests\fixtures\configs\valid-runner.toml` and confirm it reports repository identity, branch readability, tool versions, validation-command startup health, Copilot auth, and merge-safety compatibility without creating worktrees, running validation, or mutating GitHub.
- [ ] Run `uv run python -m local_issue_runner doctor --config local_issue_runner\tests\fixtures\configs\invalid-duplicate-feature-branch.toml` and confirm it exits nonzero with a specific configuration error instead of falling back to a partial run.
- [ ] Run `uv run python -m local_issue_runner plan --config local_issue_runner\tests\fixtures\configs\native-discovery.toml` and confirm it prints the effective child list, discovery mode, integration node, and the next transition without creating jobs, worktrees, or remote mutations.
- [ ] Run the `test_plan_snapshot.py` scenarios for explicit `child_issues`, cross-feature dependencies, out-of-scope dependencies, and cycles, and confirm that only valid in-scope DAGs produce ready work while offending edges surface precise blockers.
- [ ] Run `uv run python -m local_issue_runner run --once --config local_issue_runner\tests\fixtures\configs\single-child.toml` against a temp fixture repo and confirm it creates one owned child worktree from the latest remote feature-branch SHA, leaves the developer checkout unchanged, records a scope fingerprint, and persists a validation record for the exact committed tree.
- [ ] Simulate a crash after push or after PR creation, restart the runner, and confirm exactly one runner-owned PR exists with the expected head/base and ownership marker, with no duplicate push or duplicate PR.
- [ ] Create an externally published PR for the same child issue and confirm the runner surfaces a human-decision blocker, does not adopt that PR, and does not start duplicate implementation.
- [ ] Manually merge a runner-owned child PR into the feature branch, rerun reconciliation, and confirm the child issue closes, the merged result is verified against Git ancestry and recorded base/scope, and the dependent child becomes ready only after the prerequisite code is available in its base branch.
- [ ] Reopen a previously delivered child issue and confirm the runner allocates a fresh delivery, new work branch, new worktree, and new PR; invalidates dependent readiness; and reopens the parent when required without mutating historical delivery records.
- [ ] Run concurrent multi-feature scheduling fixtures and confirm independent children can run in parallel, each feature keeps its own five-slot limit, waiting PRs still consume slots, actionable owned PRs are prioritized over new work, and a blocked feature does not prevent another feature from progressing.
- [ ] Post a human review-thread comment, a bot comment, a same-account human comment, a nonempty review body, and an unchanged comment to a runner-owned PR, then confirm the runner replies exactly once per new or materially changed external input, ignores its own bookkeeping replies, and records a disposition for every handled item.
- [ ] Reopen a previously resolved review thread and confirm the runner handles it again; add a comment to a still-resolved thread and confirm the runner replies without automatically redoing the prior repair.
- [ ] Simulate required checks that are pending, missing, failing, cancelled, timed out, optional-and-failing, and eventually recovered; confirm only required checks block progress, optional checks remain visible but non-blocking, CI wait timers persist across restart, and a recovered required check can automatically resume progress.
- [ ] Simulate the same unresolved repair problem twice without verified progress and confirm the runner stops automatic repair, records the stable problem identity across restarts and delivery numbers, and requires explicit operator `retry` to continue.
- [ ] Complete every selected child in a parent and confirm the runner publishes one integration PR from the feature branch to `main`, uses a dedicated integration worktree, validates the aggregate feature, and restarts the quiet period after any integration-branch push.
- [ ] Introduce a concrete integration defect and confirm the runner creates exactly one grounded repair child, adds it to the effective child scope without rewriting the TOML file, and blocks integration merge until that child is complete and the aggregate gates are re-satisfied.
- [ ] Under `autonomy = "create_pr"`, confirm child and parent PRs can be published and maintained but never merged automatically, while `status` still shows exact merge blockers and readiness facts.
- [ ] Without a valid qualification receipt, or without readable strict protection plus at least one real required check, confirm both child and parent automerge remain unavailable even when all other visible gates are green.
- [ ] With a valid child-level qualification receipt and `autonomy = "merge_children"`, confirm a runner-owned child PR can squash-merge only when expected-head, approvals, quiet period, validation, base up-to-dateness, required checks, and feedback dispositions all pass.
- [ ] After a verified child merge, confirm cleanup removes only the clean, unused, runner-owned child worktree and unchanged child refs; dirty worktrees, ambiguous ownership, rewritten history, and advanced remote refs must block cleanup without deleting unexpected work.
- [ ] With a valid full qualification receipt and `autonomy = "merge_parents"`, confirm the parent integration PR merges via a merge commit only, the parent closes only after verified integration into `main` plus a recheck of current selected-child completeness, and the feature branch remains retained.
- [ ] Introduce last-second scope or feedback changes during the child or parent merge window and confirm the runner preserves merge evidence, surfaces the discrepancy, leaves the issue open when required, and never auto-reverts a completed merge to hide the race.
- [ ] Start a second runner against the same repository and confirm the mutation lock is refused clearly while read-only `status` still works.
- [ ] Exercise Windows paths with spaces in config paths, repository paths, validation-command executables, and runtime roots, and confirm `doctor`, `plan`, `run --once`, and validation-command startup checks all pass arguments correctly without shell interpolation bugs.
- [ ] Run `uv run pytest local_issue_runner\tests\`, `uv run ruff check local_issue_runner local_issue_runner\tests`, and `uv run pyright local_issue_runner` and confirm the full automated suite, linting, and strict typing pass.
- [ ] Run `uv run python -m local_issue_runner qualify --config local_issue_runner\tests\fixtures\configs\disposable-qualification.toml` against a developer-authorized disposable GitHub repository and confirm it records a qualification receipt with retained evidence that gates autonomy promotion exactly as specified.
